biography:
Born in a small Oxfordshire village, Steve Neal's passion for motorsport ignited early, fueled by his father's tales of rallying legends and a battered Scalextric set. He began his racing journey in karting at the age of 12, showing a natural aptitude for speed and car control. Steve quickly rose through the ranks, securing multiple regional championships before transitioning to saloon car racing. A defining moment came in 2018 during a wet race at Brands Hatch, where Steve, driving an underpowered Ford Fiesta, overtook three cars in a single corner, showcasing his exceptional car control and tactical acumen. His consistent performances earned him a coveted seat with the MINI Cooper S team. Currently, Steve is considered to be in the prime of his career, a reliable and consistent driver with the potential to challenge for championships.

Despite his calm demeanor off the track, Steve possesses a fierce competitive spirit, which has seen him gain the respect of his peers. He has been steadily improving his race craft. His quiet nature belies a determination to win, fueled by a deep love for the sport and a desire to prove his worth against more flamboyant competitors. Away from the racetrack, Steve dedicates his time to mentoring young drivers, sharing his knowledge and experience to nurture the next generation of racing talent.

The MINI Cooper S team recognized his talent and approached him for a contract. Since then, he has never looked back, dedicating all his time to racing and improving his skills. In recent years, his focus has shifted towards endurance racing. He enjoys the team aspect and the challenge of making a car last.
drivingStyle: Steve Neal is known for his smooth and precise driving style. He prioritizes consistency and tire management, often sacrificing early lap pace to ensure a strong finish. His approach to corners is calculated, favoring a late-braking technique to maximize corner exit speed. He excels under pressure, remaining calm and composed in high-stakes situations, making him a reliable and dependable driver for his team. He is also known for his ability to adapt to changing track conditions, making him a formidable competitor in wet races.
